messages:
Felix: Kicking off a playbook for the OpenRef refapp launch. Need: short hero blog, 2 bench micro-stories (cost & latency), partner co-post copy, gated webinar, and routing for inbound. Assignable?
Aria: I can write the hero blog and partner blurb. Suggest a 2-paragraph lead and a clear "Try the repo" CTA.
Jonah: Bench owner. Ill produce two single-line stats and one small PNG each: cost-per-1k and p95 delta. Will include test harness notes.
Maya: I'll handle the webinar logistics and registration form. Plan: cohort of 120, gated form, collect company_size + interest_level + use_case. Routing: company_size >= 200 -> AE, 50-199 -> SDR, <50 -> automated onboarding.
Felix: For partners, Aria can draft a 1-paragraph co-post and a short tweet they can paste. Also add a partner-friendly headline variant.
Jonah: Bench details: baseline = no cache, opt = cache+batching. Target callout: "~28% p95 drop, ~20% lower cost per 1k for conversational prompts" (I'll confirm exacts).
Aria: Blog outline: 1) problem, 2) what OpenRef includes, 3) microbench highlights, 4) how to run locally, 5) partner shoutouts, 6) webinar CTA.
Maya: Form draft: https://forms.redwood.com/openref (WIP). Webhook to /hooks/hubspot-openref. Will set hubspot property source=openref-launch and add list openref-launchers.
Felix: Social plan: tease (7d), announce (day 0), deep-dive (day +3). A/B test headlines: A) "Build an app" B) "Cut serving cost".
Jonah: I'll export bench PNGs to /assets/openref_cost.png and /assets/openref_latency.png by EOD tomorrow.
Aria: Partner ask: can we offer a co-hosted webinar with partner logo placement and a shared registration list? If yes, Ill draft outreach.
Maya: Co-hosting OK. Add a partner field on form and set referral_tag for partner tracking. We'll also offer partner registrants early office-hours slots.
marketing-bot: Reminder set: "Publish OpenRef hero post" scheduled for 7 days before event.
Felix: Owners recap: Aria = blog & partners, Jonah = benches & PNGs, Maya = form & webinar flow. Felix = coordination + publish calendar. Closing thread; ping for blockers. :sparkles:
